proposal.summary: A vulnerability was found in Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload Contact Form 7 5.0.6.1 on WordPress, leading to relative path traversal.
proposal.affected_product: Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload Contact Form 7 5.0.6.1
proposal.cwe_quote: The manipulation of the argument upload_name leads to relative path traversal.

AV.quote: It is possible to launch the attack remotely.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch the vulnerability in the affected version.

evidence_quotes.claim: The vulnerability is classified as critical.
evidence_quotes.quote: It has been classified as critical.

evidence_quotes.claim: The vulnerability leads to relative path traversal.
evidence_quotes.quote: The manipulation of the argument upload_name leads to relative path traversal.

evidence_quotes.claim: The attack can be launched remotely.
